dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Post-traumatic focal non-convulsive status epilepticus arising from left frontal encephalomalacia (left frontal lobe epilepsy secondary to prior traumatic brain injury)

Alternatives:
1. Post-ictal confusion / postictal behavioral disturbance following a focal to bilateral tonic-clonic seizure from the left frontal focus
2. Autoimmune encephalitis (serum antibody panel was not performed; though paraneoplastic antibodies were normal)
3. Chronic post-traumatic encephalopathy with interictal behavioral disturbance, without active ictal activity
